title: How We Met
synopsis: The day two worlds collided and everything changed.
story:
It was one of those days that started out ordinary. I was going about my usual routine, not expecting anything different.

But then you walked in. We talked like we had known each other forever — no awkwardness, no hesitation.

That day changed everything. I just didn't know it yet.

title: Our First Date
synopsis: Nervous outfits, nervous hearts, and a night to remember.
story:
I changed my outfit three times before you picked me up. But the moment I saw your smile, all the nerves melted away.

Dinner was wonderful, but the walk afterwards was even better. We talked for hours.

That night, I knew this was something special.

title: The Laughs We Shared
synopsis: The moment I knew I wanted to laugh with you forever.
story:
Do you remember that ridiculous thing that happened? We couldn't stop laughing — the kind where your stomach hurts.

I knew right then that I wanted to laugh with you every single day.

You have the most beautiful laugh I've ever heard.

title: One Year Together
synopsis: 365 days of learning, growing, and loving.
story:
One year. We made it look easy.

We celebrated with a quiet dinner and a walk under the stars.

Here's to many more years of this beautiful adventure.

title: Adventures Together
story:
We woke up on a Saturday and decided to just drive.

No plan, no map, just each other and the open road.

We ended up at a place we'd never heard of, watching the most beautiful sunset.

title: Three Years
synopsis: 1096 days of the most beautiful story.
story:
Three years. One thousand and ninety-six days of loving you.

Every morning I wake up next to you, every night I fall asleep in your arms — it all adds up to the most beautiful story.

I love you more today than yesterday. And I'll love you more tomorrow than today.

Happy anniversary, my love.
